row:
This is your go-to spot for everything happening at the San José Animal Shelter. Meet our amazing adoptable animals, get helpful training and behavior tips, and see behind-the-scenes moments from our shelter and community. We share success stories, adoption spotlights, educational videos, and resources to help pets and people thrive together.

Whether you are looking to adopt, foster, volunteer, or just love animals as much as we do, you are in the right place. Subscribe to stay connected, learn something new, and help us give every animal the loving home they deserve.
